mapper.select: select student_id from sam_student where status = '0' order by student_id limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select user_id as userId, student_name as studentName, student_no as studentNo from sam_student where student_id = #{studentId} limit 1
select count(1) from sam_student where status = '0'

select tp.plan_id from sam_student st join tpm_training_plan tp on tp.major_id = st.major_id and tp.del_flag = '0' and tp.publish_status = '1' and (tp.plan_year = st.enrollment_year or st.enrollment_year is null or tp.plan_year is null) where st.student_id = #{studentId} order by tp.plan_year desc, tp.plan_id desc limit 1

select cs.credit_type as creditType, cs.credit_type_name as creditTypeName, cs.required_credit as requiredCredit from tpm_credit_structure cs where cs.plan_id = #{planId} and cs.del_flag = '0' order by cs.struct_id

select count(1) from aem_grade_record gr join tpm_course_library cl on gr.course_id = cl.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.semester_id = #{semesterId} and gr.status = '0' and cl.course_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
